title: Create a bean when needed
summary: Spring Framework: Create a bean when needed. Remove @Lazy and compare the order.
introduction: @Lazy delays this bean until it is requested. The print inside its factory shows when creation happens.
learningObjectives: Create a bean when needed with Spring Framework

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save each example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. The //DEPS line lets JBang fetch Spring. These examples use the core container and do not start a web server.

blocks.title: Create a bean when needed

blocks.text: The lazy factory has not run at the first print. Requesting its bean then prints Made now.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Lazy creation delays work; it does not remove that work.
